name: Gelkak Gyromast
summary: Gelkak Gyromast is a gnome who talks like a pirate captain, found stranded along the foggy shoreline of Mist's Edge in northern Darkshore. His ship was sunk offshore by threshadons, and he wants his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, back in working order.

sections.title: Castaway on Mist's Edge
sections.body: Perched on the desolate northern coast of Darkshore just west of the ancient Ruins of Mathystra, Gelkak Gyromast represents a peculiar sight among the gloomy night elven shores. Talking like an old sea dog, the self-styled captain lost his ship to the threshadons just offshore. When he washed up on the misty sands, the key to his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, broke on the rocks, and its pieces were carried off by the crawlers, foreststriders and murlocs rummaging through the wreckage.

sections.title: The Threshwackonator Malfunction
sections.body: Once adventurers recover the key, Gyromast sends them to switch on his first mate and lead it back to him, eager to set it loose on the murlocs and beasts of the coast. The Threshwackonator 4100 follows obediently, only to malfunction and turn hostile the moment it reaches its captain, leaving the adventurers to destroy it.

faq.answer: Gelkak Gyromast is an eccentric gnome who talks like a pirate captain, stranded on the northern beach of Darkshore known as Mist's Edge, just west of the Ruins of Mathystra.

faq.q: Why is Gelkak stranded in Darkshore?
faq.answer: His ship was sunk just offshore by threshadons, and he washed up on the desolate northern coast with the broken key to his mechanical first mate.
The Threshwackonator 4100 is Gelkak's mechanical creation and self-proclaimed first mate. He wants it back in working order so it can take revenge on the murlocs and beasts of the coast.

faq.q: What help does Gelkak need from travelers?
faq.answer: Gelkak asks capable adventurers to recover the three pieces of his broken key from the crawlers, foreststriders and murlocs of the coast, then use it to start the Threshwackonator 4100 and lead it back to him.

angles.text: Seeing a fellow gnome stranded on the edge of Kalimdor is a stark reminder of how far from home a gnome's adventures can carry him.
Gelkak's predicament is a classic tale of a gnome far from home, pinning his hopes of revenge on a device as impressive as the Threshwackonator 4100.
